steps.content: The rhythmic tapping continues. Reid is visibly relaxed, even in the mood to joke.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: Sounds like they're in good spirits.
But Teto, the communications officer, has gone pale.

steps.speaker: Teto
steps.content: By my calculations, they should've been back long ago...
You close your eyes, listening to the rhythm of the metal pipe.
Each strike is heavier than the last, the tempo quickening.
After one last, sharp clang, the tapping comes to an abrupt halt.
Face... the darkness... the fear... Face... yourself...
You shudder violently, instinctively moving to shield Shin and Laura.
The light in the wheelhouse goes out.
In the darkness, a familiar, nauseating feeling washes over you. You hear the writhing of something wet, feel the gaze of countless eyes from the shadows...
You have no time to think. Cold, clammy tendrils have coiled noiselessly around your limbs, dragging you into the dark Abyss...
